questions.stem_text:
Who defined jurisprudence as the knowledge of things divine and human, the science of
right and wrong
Which proposition below is the most powerful refutation of Bentham's felicific calculus?

options.A: Happiness is less important than economic prosperity.
options.B: It is impossible to calculate all the consequences of one's acts.
options.C: Pain and pleasure are inevitable features of life.
options.D: Utilitarianism fails to take account of differences in social background.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It is impossible to calculate all the consequences of one's acts.

questions.stem_text: Lyotard's dictum 'I define postmodern as incredulity toward meta-narratives' means:
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Universal values are meaningless.

questions.stem_text:
Which case was the first to define the meaning of the doctrine of 'margin of appreciation'
as applied by the European Court of Human Rights?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Handyside v UK (1976)

questions.stem_text:
What other criteria were imposed by the Badinter Commission on the former Yugoslav
republics?

options.A: The Commission required a commitment to submit disputes to the ICJ
options.B: The Commission required a change in boundaries
options.C: The Commission required a commitment to human rights and democracy
options.D: The Commission required an exchange of ethnic populations

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The Commission required a commitment to human rights and democracy
